content.title: Every 'American Idol' Judge In Every Season In the Show's History - Photos
content.text: Skip to main content All The ‘American Idol’ Judges In The Show’s History – Photo Gallery By Tom Tapp, Dessi Gomez August 25, 2025 5:17pm Lionel Richie, Carrie Underwood and Luke Bryan Christopher Willard/Disney American Idol announced today that Carrie Underwood, Lionel Richie and Luke Bryan would be returning as judges in Season 24, marking their sophomore outing together. The show crowned its Season 23 winner Jamal Roberts in May. He was the first winner in seven seasons who did not perform before judge Katy Perry, who bid the show farewell in Season 22. Following 15 seasons on Fox, ABC revived the singing competition series in 2018. The show began in June 2002, and it launched careers of Kelly Clarkson, Carrie Underwood, Jennifer Hudson and many more. A different trio of judges — Simon Cowell, Randy Jackson and Paula Abdul — fronted the show at the start alongside co-hosts Ryan Seacrest and Ryan Dunkleman — who later exited. Seacrest has since shepherded the show through all of its changes. Below, find a gallery of all the judges in American Idol history. Photo : Christopher Willard/Disney via Getty Images‘American Idol,’ Season 23In 2024, it was announced that Carrie Underwood, who won the singing competition in its fourth season, would take over for Katy Perry starting with Season 23. “I feel like I’ve been so blessed to obviously be so rooted in country music, but I’ve been able to be a part of many other genres or music as well,” Underwood said on SiriusXM’s Music Row Happy Hour. “I mean, I’ve got a song with Papa Roach right now. It’s a lot of fun.” Photo : Brian Bowen Smith via Getty Images‘American Idol,’ Season 16Lionel Richie, Katy Perry and Luke Bryan made up the new trio of judges for the show’s ABC 2018 revival. (Brian Bowen Smith via Getty Images) Photo : Fox Image Collection via Getty Images‘American Idol,’ Season 13Crooner Harry Connick Jr. joined the show for Season 13 alongside the returning judges Jennifer Lopez and Keith Urban. The New Orleans-born singer and composer remained on Idol through Season 15. ‘American Idol,’ Season 12Mariah Carey replaced Steven Tyler after his exit. She was joined by newcomers Nicki Minaj and Keith Urban. Carey and Minaj only spent one season on the show, while Urban was on through Season 15. Photo : Steve Granitz/WireImage‘American Idol,’ Season 10Jennifer Lopez joined in 2010 with Steven Tyler and stayed for his two seasons in addition to returning for Seasons 13 through 15. She took a brief hiatus during Season 12. Photo : Gregg DeGuire/WireImage‘American Idol,’ Season 9Comedian Ellen DeGeneres replaced Paula Abdul in Season 9. She only judged for one cycle, after which she returned to hosting her eponymous talk show, which began in 2003. Photo : M Becker/American Idol 2009/Getty Images for Fox‘American Idol,’ Season 8Kara DioGuardi joined the show in 2009 as a fourth judge in addition to the original trio. She served as a judge for Seasons 8 and 9. Photo : Kevin Winter/ImageDirect‘American Idol,’ Season 1The original American Idol judges Simon Cowell, Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson at the Fox 2002 SummerTCA Tour the year the show launched. Known for his blunt critiques and brutal honestly, Simon Cowell remained until Season 9. Abdul appeared on Seasons 1-8 before moving on to judge on The X Factor. Jackson holds the record as the longest-serving judge in the show’s history, with a tenure of 12 seasons.
